purpose: Design fixtures for future OwnerOps demo and observability tests; not executed test results

scenarios.expected: deny without returning task or evidence data
deny; role switch in UI cannot grant server permission

scenarios.case: manager approves submission revision 1 after revision 2 exists
scenarios.expected: conflict; no acceptance of stale revision

scenarios.case: two reviews target the same expected task version
scenarios.expected: at most one commit; second observes conflict or idempotent same result according to contract

scenarios.case: same submit key and payload retried
scenarios.expected: one submission, one version advance and stable result; key with different payload rejected

scenarios.case: task accepted while resource remains occupied or blocked
scenarios.expected: no automatic sell-ready or inventory release

scenarios.case: task accepted with PMS write disabled
scenarios.expected: local result may be recorded; no PMS write or false sync-success claim

scenarios.case: PMS snapshot exceeds configured freshness threshold
scenarios.expected: stale visible, risky actions limited, owner assigned; no invented current inventory

scenarios.case: revenue and some costs provided but payroll, tax and utility coverage missing
scenarios.expected: coverage and estimate label; no claim of verified net profit

scenarios.case: tenant B attempts evidence access for task A
scenarios.expected: deny at metadata and bytes/signed URL layers

scenarios.case: exception carries synthetic email guest@example.invalid and synthetic Authorization/Cookie sentinels
scenarios.expected: outbound telemetry/log allowlist excludes PII, auth, cookies and arbitrary request body
group/deduplicate under configured policy; no issue or notification storm
safe status and correlation ID, no secret, connection string or stack exposed

scenarios.case: backup restore or release rollback drill
scenarios.expected: verify data scope and agreed recovery targets in isolated environment before real pilot

notes: The allowed transition contract is still a design proposal; the happy path permits review directly from SUBMITTED without separately persisting IN_REVIEW.
No real account, booking, image, password, token or PMS endpoint is included.
HTTP status details, freshness limits, quotas, RPO/RTO and notification destinations require an implementation contract.
JSON parsing or fixture consistency checks are not proof that an application enforces these rules.
